cards.audioText: B: [Your callsign is CSN9302, you're parking at bay 235. You're ready for pushback, contact Guangzhou Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你的呼号是南方9302，你现在在235号机位，你准备好推出了，联系广州地面。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN9302, bay 235, ready for pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，南方9302，235号机位，请求推出。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, standby, expect 20 minutes delay. Thunderstorm is approaching the airport, numerous aircraft holding for weather improvement.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，稍等，预计延误20分钟，雷暴正接近机场，很多飞机正在等待天气变好。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN9302, report tug is ready.
B: [Tell the controller the tug is ready and you're ready for pushback.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 南方9302，拖车就位后报。
B：【告知管制员拖车已就位，你准备好推出了。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN9302, the tug is ready, and we're ready for pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，南方9302，拖车已就位，我们准备好推出了。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, pushback approved, facing east, runway 19, standby for startup.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，可以推出，朝东，跑道19，稍等开车。
cards.referenceText: Pushback approved, facing east, runway 19, standby for startup, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出，朝东，跑道19，稍等开车，南方9302。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you've been waiting for the startup clearance for about 15 minutes, contact Guangzhou Ground for startup.]
cards.audioTextZh: B:【你等你的开车许可已经等了15分钟了，联系广州地面，申请开车。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN9302, we've been waiting for about 15 minutes, request startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，南方9302，我们已经等了15分钟了，申请开车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, expect departure at 49, startup at own discretion, QNH1008, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，预计离场时间49分，自行决定开车，修压1008，准备好滑行时报。
cards.referenceText: Expect departure at 49, startup at own discretion, QNH1008, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计离场时间49分，自行决定开车，修压1008，南方9302。
广州地面，南方9302，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, taxi via J, D, T3 and T4 to the holding point of runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 南方9302，经由滑行道J，D，T3和T4滑行到跑道19外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via J, D, T3 and T4 to the holding point of runway 19, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道J，D，T3和T4滑行到跑道19外等待点，南方9302。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, hold short of T3, give way to A320 crossing from right to left.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，在T3外等待，给从右向左穿越的A320让路。
cards.referenceText: Hold short of T3, give way to A320, CSN9302.

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, traffic is clear, continue taxi via D, T3 and T4 to the holding point of runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，冲突解除，继续沿D，T3和T4滑行到跑道19外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi via D, T3 and T4 to the holding point of runway 19, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续沿D，T3和T4滑行到跑道19外等待点，南方9302。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you're at the holding point F1, runway 19, you're fully ready, contact Guangzhou Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在在F1等待点，跑道19，你完全准备好了，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN9302, holding point F1, runway 19, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，南方9302，F1等待点，跑道19，完全准备好了。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN9302, line up and wait runway 19, caution thunderstorm building up at the departure end of runway 19.
B: [Read back ATC's clearance and request right turn when airborne due weather.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方9302，上跑道19等待，注意跑道19一边（离场边）上有雷暴正在生成。
B：【复诵管制的许可，由于天气，起飞后请求右转。】
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait runway 19, request right turn when airborne due weather, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道19等待，由于天气，起飞后请求右转，南方9302。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, turn right heading 120, runway 19, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 180 degrees, 5m/s.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，右转航向120，跑道19，可以起飞，地面风180度，5米每秒。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 120, runway 19, cleared for takeoff, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向120，跑道19，可以起飞，南方9302。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you're airborne, maintaining 2100m, heading 120. Contact Guangzhou Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在起飞了，正保持2100米，航向120，联系广州进近。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN9302, airborne, maintaining 2100m, heading 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，南方9302，正保持2100米，航向120。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, climb to 2700m on QNH 1008.

B: [During climb, suddenly you've been struck by a foreign object, possibly hail strike. Your instruments are indicating incorrectly. Report this situation to Guangzhou Approach and request return to land.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【在爬升过程中，你突然遭遇外物撞击，可能是冰雹。仪表显示异常。向广州进近报告此情况，请求返航着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN9302, we've been struck by a foreign object, possibly hail strike, our instruments are indicating incorrectly, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，南方9302，我们被外物撞击，可能是冰雹，仪表显示异常，请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, roger, descend to 1500m, expect radar vectors for final runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，下1500米，预计雷达引导至19跑道五边。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1500m, expect radar vectors for final runway 19, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下1500米，预计雷达引导至19跑道五边，南方9302。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, runway 19, cleared to land.
